resources.string: An app asked to create or add to notes through the automation API
Nothing was saved. Review it in Settings → Allowed apps.

Only apps you allow here can use automation. An app that asks shows up under \"Waiting for approval\"; what it asked for is not kept, so run its task again after allowing it. An app is trusted by its package name and signing certificate: if a different app is installed under the same name later, it has to ask again.
%1$s (%2$s) will be able to create notes, add text to any note and open notes in your iCloud account without showing you the editor. It can never delete or replace a note. Only allow apps you trust.
